docs.title: AtiFlow v2.0 — Figma vs App Gap Analysis
docs.text:
Figma file: Ati Flow — Admin flow Designs section (node 574-2820) Figma version: 2355537039279972312  |  Last modified: 2026-05-20 App screenshots taken: 2026-05-22  |  Report date: May 2026

This document compares every admin screen in the Figma design file against the live AtiFlow v2.0 app. Each section shows Figma designs (left) and app screenshots (right) side by side, followed by a gap table.

docs.title: 🔴 Critical — Design / Implementation Mismatch
docs.text:
